context: A bad config edit reaches the running server

checklist.name: hook_on_failure
checklist.description: Explains that Viper calls the change hook even when its reread failed, leaving the old values in the instance, so the hook cannot detect a bad edit by reading it.

checklist.name: validate_snapshot
checklist.description: On each change, loads and validates a complete new snapshot (for example with the startup loader on a fresh `viper.New()` instance) and reports the error instead of applying it when decoding or validation fails, so `rate.limit: 0` is rejected.

checklist.name: safe_publish
checklist.description: Publishes the snapshot with an `atomic.Pointer`, a mutex, or a channel, and does not have handlers read the watched Viper instance.

checklist.name: test
checklist.description: Adds a test that applies a valid edit, then an invalid one, and asserts the error is reported and the previous snapshot is still in effect.
